description: The source report combines two surveys, a literature review and SWOT analysis of large thermal energy storage. It records how district-heating customers and operators value cost, carbon savings, resilience, supply security and visibility, including willingness to pay and acceptable investment payback. The information concerns actual storage adoption and economic appraisal; no machine-readable respondent data, representative sample size or geographic survey coverage is established. The related presentation by the same research team summarises non-market benefit categories and is retained as supporting context, without assuming identical survey records. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results. The native deposit declares CC-BY-4.0 and public access without a stated charge.
